blocks.prompt: 13. How many necklaces can be made from 6 beads of different colours?
blocks.explanation:
Haar (necklace) ke daane gol daire mein hote hain, aur haar ko palta bhi ja sakta hai.
Plan: Case-II wali gol tarteeb, jis mein clockwise aur anticlockwise ek hi maani jati hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 6 mukhtalif rangon ke daane (beads).
Humein find karna hai: kitne mukhtalif haar ban sakte hain.
Tareeqa: Case-II: \(\dfrac{(n - 1)!}{2}\).

Daanon ki gol tarteeb
\[(6 - 1)! = 5! = 120\]
Kyun: Haar ko ghumane se naya haar nahi banta, is liye ek daane ko fix kar ke baaqi 5 daane 5! tareeqon se lagte hain. Yeh Case-I ki ginti hai.

Haar palatne ka asar
\[\dfrac{5!}{2} = \dfrac{120}{2} = 60\]
Kyun: Haar ko palat dein to rangon ki tarteeb ulti nazar aati hai, lekin haar wahi hai; gale mein daal kar koi farq nahi pata chalta. Is liye har haar do dafa gina gaya tha aur 2 se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: Sirf 5! = 120 likh dena ghalat hai; haar ke sawal mein 2 se divide karna bhoolna nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{Case-I} = 120 = 2 \times 60 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Case-II ka jawab hamesha Case-I ka aadha hota hai. Computer se 6 mukhtalif daanon ke haar (ghumane aur palatne ko ek maan kar) gine gaye to bhi 60 aaye. Sawal 12 ki key ring ka jawab bhi isi wajah se 60 hai.
